# Files that neither CI nor the shipped game use: a pull request that only
# touches these skips CI (its jobs report as skipped, and the "CI" check
# passes).
# One bash `case` glob per line, matched against the path from the repo
# root (`*` also matches `/`). Lines starting with # and blank lines are
# ignored.
#
# Markdown files are not listed: CI lints them.

LICENSE
.vscode/*
*.code-workspace
.cspell.jsonc
.editorconfig
.envrc
.gitignore
